prompt:
# Decorative prop d10068: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10068/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the long slim brown tool head, cylindrical upper striking section with many small pale part, silver cap, tightly wrapped lower grip, metal bands, and small silver butt cap. Render one complete upright part tool head on genuine transparent alpha..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: A harmless static decorative prop for a cosy fantasy game, texture sheet only. Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the long slim brown tool head, cylindrical upper striking section with many small pale part, silver cap, tightly wrapped lower grip, metal bands, and small silver butt cap. Render one complete upright part tool head on genuine transparent alpha.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10068/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input ordering: image 1 is paint_mask_guide.png, the edit target whose positions and silhouettes must stay fixed. Image 2 is design_reference.png for material detail. Image 3 is icon_x8.png for color only. Preserve the guide's ten small objects in their exact cells and orientations, including foreshortened end views. Do not replace this atlas with an upright single object. Wood is yellow in mask; leather grip green; metal studs and all caps and bands red. Output a single transparent PNG.
CORRECTIVE GENERATION: Preserve exact guide silhouettes especially lower material-mask rows. There must be ZERO stray pixels, speckles, splatter, glow, or rough brush edges outside the silhouettes. Crisp clean flat segmentation shapes, exact solid red/yellow/green interiors. Both halves must share identical silhouette geometry. Match source wood grain rather than leather-like knots on wooden striking section. Paint remains unlit.
validation_notes: Layout visually checked. Residual stray pixels remain around material-mask silhouettes after the one allowed correction; raw tool output preserved.
